subject: Demo recap + proposed POC engagement plan for Loomscape
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@loomscape.ai>, Lucy Grant <lucy@loomscape.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC engagement plan for Loomscape

Hi Samir / Lucy —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our demo and a recommended POC engagement plan to keep momentum. I captured the items we agreed on and a proposed timeline below.

Top-line recap from the call:
- Primary use-case: augment customer support with retrieval-augmented generation for knowledge-base articles (short answers + suggested KB updates).
- Key success metric: 30% reduction in average handle time for tier-1 queries and precision >= 85% on answer relevance in our eval set.
- Data scope: recent 18 months of KB + 10k anonymized ticket samples (you confirmed permission for redaction).

Proposed 4-week POC (high level):
Week 0 (prep, owners): data handoff (Loomscape) + access to sample KB; Redwood to provide onboarding checklist and ingestion template.
Week 1 (ingest & baseline): ingest sample KB, run baseline embeddings, evaluate retrieval recall/precision.
Week 2 (integration & demo): integrate retrieval + Redwood hosted model variant (low-latency profile), run internal QA, live demo to your CS team.
Week 3 (evaluate & tune): run evaluation suite, tune retrieval parameters, produce final report and recommended rollout config.

Owners / resourcing (proposed):
- Loomscape: Samir (project lead), Lucy (CS SME), Procurement (contracts).
- Redwood: Vivek (engagement lead), Marissa (solutions engineer), Aditya (infrastructure support).

Deliverables:
- Ingestion checklist + validated sample ingestion (artifact: loomscape-poc-schedule.xlsx)
- Weekly status notes + evaluation dashboard link
- Final evaluation report & recommended configuration (artifact attached: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf)

Open items to confirm by EOD tomorrow (Wed):
1) Final sample dataset access and PII redaction timeline.
2) Confirmation of Loomscape test environment (staging API endpoint) or sample export.
3) Any procurement constraints / PO timing we should be aware of.

If that looks good I'll kick off scheduling with Marissa and we can send a short MOU (non-binding) to outline scope.

Thanks!

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: loomscape-poc-schedule.xlsx; redwood-poc-checklist.pdf; success-criteria-draft.md

From: Samir Desai <samir@loomscape.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucy Grant <lucy@loomscape.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@loomscape.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC engagement plan for Loomscape

Vivek —

Appreciate the clear plan and timeline. A few quick notes/questions from our side: 

1) Success criteria: the AHT reduction target looks right, but for relevance we'd prefer a slightly higher threshold (>= 88%) for the final eval to sign off. Can Redwood include both 85% (midpoint) and 88% (final sign-off) in the report?
2) Data scope: we'll deliver the 10k anonymized tickets by Friday but need Redwood to confirm the exact redaction template (PII fields listed).
3) Procurement: we'll loop in Procurement for the MOU; they typically want a 30-day trial clause and an initial statement of data handling controls.

If you can add the dual-threshold to the success-criteria doc and share the redaction template, we can greenlight the data handoff Friday.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Desai
Head of Customer Experience, Loomscape
samir@loomscape.ai | +1 (650) 555-2233

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@loomscape.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 12:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC engagement plan for Loomscape

Samir / Vivek —

Thanks — I can take point on the ingestion checklist and redaction template. I'll attach the template as "success-criteria-draft.md" (also added to the Drive folder). A couple operational notes: 

- We recommend providing a mapping file that links ticket fields to our ingestion schema (Aditya will validate).
- For the 30-day trial clause — we typically scope the trial to 30 days of active testing but include a 60-day data retention window post-trial for debugging; Procurement, if that doesn't work we can discuss.
- Internal SWEs: Aditya will allocate 2 days in Week 1 for ingestion validation; Marissa will run Week 2 integration and the customer demo.

I'll update the success criteria doc with both 85% (interim) and 88% (final sign-off) targets and re-upload by EOD.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0147

Attachments: success-criteria-draft.md

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@loomscape.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@loomscape.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC engagement plan for Loomscape

Samir / Procurement —

Great — appreciate the quick turnaround. Next steps from Redwood: 
- Marissa will share the updated success-criteria-draft.md and the redaction template by EOD today (Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-loomscape-poc).
- Once Loomscape confirms the sample dataset (target: Fri 14 May), Aditya will validate ingestion in our staging environment and confirm by Mon 17 May.
- We'll send an MOU (non-binding) that includes the 30-day active trial + 60-day retention window; Procurement please flag any changes.

Can we confirm a 30-minute kickoff on Monday 17 May at 10:00 AM PT to align on handoff and timeline? If that works I'll send calendar invite and include the meeting agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

— Vivek
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Procurement Team <procurement@loomscape.ai>

Subject: Re: MOU / trial clause questions

Vivek —

Procurement: the 30-day active trial + 60-day retention window sounds okay provided we have a short data handling appendix that lists encryption and access controls. Please include that with the MOU.

Thanks,
Loomscape Procurement
